description: Server-side UET events posted to capi.uet.microsoft.com/v1/{tagId}/events, including the JSON event payload. Browser UET is vendor/microsoft-uet.

params.name: tag_id
params.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID, and it travels in the path as /v1/{tagId}/events.
params.fix_hint: Put the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising in the path as /v1/{tagId}/events.

params.name: data
params.description: Microsoft documents `data` as the list of events. An empty list sends nothing.
params.fix_hint: Send at least one event in `data`.

params.name: eventType
params.description: It is the event type. Microsoft documents `pageLoad` or `custom`.

params.name: eventTime
params.description: It is Unix epoch time in seconds UTC. Microsoft documents seconds, so a 13-digit value is milliseconds and the wrong unit.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, a 10-digit Unix timestamp, not milliseconds.

params.name: eventId
params.description: It identifies the event so UET JavaScript and CAPI can deduplicate. Microsoft documents it as required for deduplication.
params.fix_hint: Set `eventId` to the same value the UET tag sent.

params.name: eventName
params.description: It is the custom conversion action. Microsoft documents it for custom conversion goals.

params.name: eventSourceUrl
params.description: It is the page URL. Microsoft documents it as required on `pageLoad` events.
params.fix_hint: Set `eventSourceUrl` to the absolute page URL.

params.name: pageLoadId
params.description: It links custom events to a page load. Microsoft documents a v4 UUID.

params.name: adStorageConsent
params.description: It is the advertising-storage consent signal. Microsoft documents `G` for granted and `D` for denied.

params.name: userData
params.description: Microsoft documents `userData` as required, with at least one supported identifier.
params.fix_hint: Add a `userData` object with at least one of `anonymousId`, `externalId`, `em`, `ph`, `msclkid`, `idfa`, or `gaid`.

params.name: userData.anonymousId
params.description: It is the guest visitor ID, also used for ID Sync.

params.name: userData.externalId
params.description: It is an anonymized signed-in user ID.

params.name: userData.em
params.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the email. Microsoft documents lowercase hex after trim and lowercase.
params.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: userData.ph
params.description: It is the SHA-256 hex digest of the phone number.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the phone, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: userData.msclkid
params.description: It is the Microsoft Click ID. Microsoft documents it as a UUID.
params.fix_hint: Send the `msclkid` captured from the landing URL as a UUID.

params.name: userData.idfa
params.description: It is the iOS Identifier for Advertisers.

params.name: userData.gaid
params.description: It is the Android advertising ID.

params.name: userData.clientIpAddress
params.description: It is the visitor IP, IPv4 or IPv6, sent unhashed. Microsoft documents it as preferred.

params.name: userData.clientUserAgent
params.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed. Microsoft documents it as preferred.

params.name: customData.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `customData.value`.
params.fix_hint: Use a three-letter code such as `USD`.

params.name: customData.value
params.description: It is the revenue value for variable-revenue goals. Microsoft documents a decimal number together with `currency`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `123.45`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: customData.eventValue
params.description: It is the event value for custom conversion goals. Microsoft documents a float.

rules.message: `userData` carries none of the identifiers Microsoft requires. Send `anonymousId`, `externalId`, `em`, `ph`, `msclkid`, `idfa`, or `gaid`.
rules.fix_hint: Add at least one supported identifier inside `userData`.

rules.message: The event is `pageLoad` but carries no `eventSourceUrl`. Microsoft documents the page URL as required on page load events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `eventSourceUrl` to the absolute page URL.

rules.message: The event sends `customData.value` without `customData.currency`. Microsoft documents the ISO 4217 code together with the revenue value.
The event sends `customData.currency` without `customData.value`. Microsoft documents both together.
rules.fix_hint: Add `customData.value` as a number, with no currency symbol.

rules.message: `userData.em` carries what looks like a raw email address. Microsoft documents SHA-256 lowercase hex.
rules.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, hash with SHA-256, and send the 64-character hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Microsoft documents `clientIpAddress` and `clientUserAgent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent.
